name: Call of Earth

angles.text: The Call of Earth marks an initiate's journey into communion with the spirits of stone and soil, demanding proof of resolve before granting deeper insight.
Shamanistic trials like the Call of Earth form a foundational rite for spiritual practitioners among the peoples of the Horde.

faq.answer: Call of Earth is a rite of passage for spiritual initiates, requiring the petitioner to gather requested items to prove their perseverance and steadfastness before moving on to the next stage of training.
faq.q: What is the Call of Earth?

faq.answer: Completing this task demonstrates your grit and unwavering determination, showing your mentor that your focus is firm enough to shoulder greater spiritual responsibilities.
faq.q: What does finishing this trial demonstrate?

faq.answer: Having proven your resolve, your instructor deems you ready for the next step along your path of elemental communion.
faq.q: What happens after completing the Call of Earth?

faq.answer: Earth represents stability, steadfast resolve, and unyielding strength. An initiate must prove their own endurance before they can truly commune with the earth spirits.
faq.q: Why must an initiate commune with earth?

faq.answer: A spiritual teacher or shaman mentor guides initiates through the trial to test their discipline and readiness to bond with the spirits.
faq.q: Who oversees the Call of Earth?

faq.answer: The Call of Earth is tied directly to elemental attunement, serving as a formative test for those walking the path of the elements.
faq.q: Who is eligible to undertake this trial?

sections.body: The Call of Earth is a foundational trial for aspiring practitioners of the elements. Initiates are tasked with fulfilling specific demands to test their patience, resilience, and connection to the stubborn, enduring nature of the earth. Fulfilling the request demonstrates that an adventurer possesses the inner fortitude required to commune with primeval forces.
sections.title: A Test of Resolve

sections.body: Upon returning with the requested offerings, the mentor recognizes the petitioner's unquestionable grit and determination. Having proven steadfast in the face of elemental demands, the initiate earns recognition and is deemed prepared to undertake the next step of their spiritual journey.
sections.title: The Next Step

summary: The Call of Earth is an elemental trial undertaken by spiritual initiates to prove their steadfastness. By retrieving requested materials, the petitioner demonstrates their grit and determination to their instructor. Successfully enduring the task confirms their readiness to proceed to the next stage of their training.
